title.hr: Rad iznad drugih: predmeti koji padaju i zona ispod
title.en: Working above others: dropped objects and the zone below

concept.hr: Ispušteni predmet udara s E = m·g·h; zona ispod, uzica i ograda čuvaju ljude
concept.en: A dropped tool hits with E = m·g·h; a zone, tethers and rails keep it off people

summary.hr: Radnik na ljestvama, skeli ili podiznoj platformi iznad prolaza: tjedan padova, zona ispod, alat na uzici, rubna letva i pad samog radnika.
summary.en: A worker on a ladder, a platform or a lift above a busy route: a week of drops, a zone below, tools tied on, a toe board and the worker's own fall.
